title: Drunk and incapable of taking care of himself or herself in any public place
punishment: Fine ≤ $1,000 or imprisonment ≤ 1 month or both; repeat offender: Fine ≤ $2,000 or ≤ 3 months or both
note: Arrestable without warrant per s.30 — any police officer may arrest person offending, in the officer's view, against ANY provision of this Act. Overrides CPC First Schedule term defaults (<3 yrs would otherwise be non-arrestable).

title: Whilst drunk appears in public place or trespass premises and conducts self so as to cause annoyance to any person
punishment: Fine ≤ $1,000 or imprisonment ≤ 6 months or both; repeat offender: Fine ≤ $2,000 or ≤ 6 months or both
note: Arrestable without warrant per LCSCA s.30. Overrides CPC defaults.

title: Fails to comply with direction under s.14(3)(a) to leave the public place or premises
punishment: Fine ≤ $1,000 or imprisonment ≤ 6 months or both; repeat: Fine ≤ $2,000 or ≤ 6 months or both

title: Consumption of liquor in a public place during the no-public drinking period (subject to s.12 exceptions)
punishment: See Act for base penalty; enhanced up to 1.5× if in Liquor Control Zone (s.16)
note: Arrestable per s.30. Always verify current penalty text on SSO.

title: Hinders or obstructs public officer or auxiliary police officer acting in discharge of duties under this Act
punishment: Fine ≤ $2,500 or imprisonment ≤ 3 months or both

title: Knowingly or recklessly provides false or misleading information or document in relation to application or appeal
punishment: Fine ≤ $5,000; repeat offender: Fine ≤ $10,000 or ≤ 3 months or both

title: Unauthorised access to computer material
punishment: Imprisonment ≤ 2 years or fine ≤ $5,000 or both (higher for subsequent/damage)
note: Check Act for exact; many CMA offences are arrestable by nature or CPC. Verify SSO.

title: Intentionally causing harassment, alarm or distress
punishment: Fine ≤ $5,000 or imprisonment ≤ 6 months or both
note: Confirm arrest powers; many POHA are non-arrestable by default but check Act.
